The cylindrical and spherical coordinate substitutions in Section 15.7 are special cases of a substitution method that pictures changes of variables in triple integrals as transformations of three-dimensional regions. The method is like the method for double integrals given by Equation (2) except that now we work in three dimensions instead of two.

x = g(u, y, w), y = h(u, y, w), z = k(u, y, w),
